text:
Ethan M: Quick thread for tonight's NYC side event (booth + 10-min lightning talk). Need final on swag, lead flow, legal on one metric callout, and who is handling onsite social.
Priya S: Swag vendor just texted - the embroidered hats are delayed until 5pm. We still have shirts, stickers, and the new benchmark postcards. Can we pivot hats -> extra postcards?
Liam (events): That's fine. We'll reallocate the hat box to printed postcards and a small roll-up stand for the benchmark graphic. ETA for posters?
Priya S: Poster print shop can do 4 posters by 4:30pm same-day. I uploaded print PDF to their portal.
Aria: For lead capture: QR goes to the short form that signs people up for webinar + downloads benchmark PDF. We should tag source=nyc-side-event and platform=instore.
Ben C: HubSpot tags in place. Also added a webhook to zap to our AE queue if company_size >= 50 OR intent_score > 70. Test payload worked.
swag-bot: Swag order update:
```
Order 9876: Shirts (200), Stickers (600), Postcards (300), Hats (delayed)
Action: swap hat qty -> +100 postcards
```
Ethan M: Thanks. On the social copy: short X and LinkedIn variants. Draft X: "At tonight's NYC side event? Visit booth S4: LLM demos, new benchmark insights & swag. Scan to join our webinar waitlist." Link with QR image.
Aria: LinkedIn needs enterprise framing. Suggest: "See how teams cut inference cost and latency with Redwood Inference. Live demos at booth S4 tonight. Download our benchmark and join the webinar."
Ben C: Legal flagged the phrase "cut inference cost" as a claim. legal-bot, can you advise on safer language?
legal-bot: Avoid quantifiers without backing. Suggest: "reduce inference cost and latency in our tests" and include link to methodology.
Ethan M: OK update: "See how teams reduced inference cost and latency in our tests. Live demos at booth S4 tonight. Download the benchmark + join the webinar."
Priya S: Who's posting on the company channels tonight? I can do X/LinkedIn if Aria can handle on-site IG stories.
Aria: I can do IG + capture short demo clips for Reels. Need the QR image and bench-graph assets.
Liam (events): AV note: venue only gives 10A per table. We're using battery pack for the demo laptop, but bring a single power strip. Also need mic stand and HDMI.
Ethan M: Demo script for lightning talk (10 min): 3-min product narrative, 4-min live demo (two prompts), 2-min benchmark highlights + CTA, 1-min outro. Who's presenting?
Ben C: I'll co-present with Ethan for the technical demo portion. We'll keep the slides to 5.
Priya S: HubSpot workflow check: form submission -> tag=nyside2026 -> send immediate email (webinar invite) -> wait 48h -> send benchmark follow-up with deeper methodology link. Also create lead owner assignment if company_size>50.
Ben C: Confirmed. Also add cookie to track utm_campaign=nyc-side. Aria, ensure QR has UTM param baked in.
Aria: Will create bit.ly and QR with utm_campaign=nyc-side-event-2026.
Ethan M: Parking/entry: ops-bot, confirm staff passes + load-in window.
ops-bot: Load-in window: 16:00-17:00. Staff passes emailed to list: Ethan M, Ben C, Aria, Liam. Parking permit for 1 vehicle (Lot C) attached.
Priya S: One more on onsite lead flow: can we have a physical clipboard backup for people who prefer not to scan QR? We'll transcribe into the form later.
Liam (events): Yes bring clipboard + pen. We'll have two people handling transcription at the end of the night.
Ben C: Demo prep note: preload two prompt sets: one short completion and one long-context retrieval use-case. Show cached KV in the long example to highlight latency improvement.
Ethan M: Also include a 1-slide methodology snapshot for the benchmark: dataset, model variants, token accounting. Link to full doc in follow-up email.
Aria: Onsite creative: I'll pin a small benchmark infographic on the table and hand out postcards with a scannable QR on the tear-off.
Priya S: Email copy for immediate auto-email after scan: subject: "Thanks for stopping by — Webinar invite + Benchmark" body short with CTA, link to calendar, and methodology link. I put a draft in the Marketing Drive.
Ben C: Final checklist for tonight:
- Priya: prints + postcards
- Liam: AV + mic + power strip
- Aria: QR + IG stories + Reels
- Ethan+Ben: slides + demo laptop image + local model variants cached
- ops-bot: load-in passes and parking
ops-bot: Reminder sent at 15:30 to staff.
Ethan M: Great. If hats arrive late we'll include them in follow-up mailers. Otherwise ready to roll. I'll post a final "we're live" message at 18:45 with the QR image and the X/LinkedIn post.
Priya S: See you all there. :rocket:
